articles.summary: IonQ advances to Stage C of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative under an agreement worth up to $300M to validate utility-scale quantum computing.
articles.title: IonQ Advances to Final Stage of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative

articles.summary: IonQ researchers combine cat states and classical scheduler codes to speed up qLDPC error correction: up to 74x faster Clifford and 5x faster Toffoli gates.
articles.title: How qLDPC with Scheduled Error Correction Unlocks Faster Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers

articles.summary: IonQ achieves a record 1 kHz quantum interconnect rate between a trapped ion qubit and quantum memory, advancing scalable distributed quantum computing.
articles.title: IonQ Demonstrates World-First Quantum Memory-Enhanced Interconnect for Distributed Quantum Applications

articles.summary: IonQ acquires Zero Trust leader Elisity for $1.3B to integrate post-quantum cryptography and QKD, securing enterprise networks against emerging threats.
articles.title: IonQ to Acquire Elisity to Accelerate Zero Trust for the Quantum Era

articles.summary: IonQ has now been selected to advance to Stage C of QBI, the initiative’s final and most rigorous phase. It’s a major milestone for IonQ: under an agreement with a potential value of up to $300 million, DARPA will independently evaluate multiple generations of our Superion quantum computers through 2029, testing whether the engineering roadmap we’ve laid out holds up in practice.
articles.title: What It Means to Put a Quantum Roadmap to the Test
